documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for To Consider Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever sales, EBITDA, profit before tax, and PAT for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, driven by healthy demand across segments and operational efficiencies. Management highlighted strong growth across standalone and consolidated operations, along with expansion initiatives in export markets like Africa and North America. The company expects sustained growth momentum supported by ongoing customer validations, new product developments, and conservative revenue growth projections. Additionally, management noted upcoming capacity and technological enhancements, including the dynamometer installation for brakes and targeted capacity additions funded through internal accruals. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q1FY27 investor presentation highlighting quarterly consolidated performance and future growth strategies.

guidance.claim: The company expects a total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: Management targets Alkop revenue of INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The company projects export share to potentially reach up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a conservative year-on-year growth guidance of 20% plus.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an overall turnover growth rate of 25% year-on-year for the next few years.
guidance.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

guidance.claim: Management is very optimistic and will take all-out efforts to reach INR 500 crores by '28.
guidance.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

guidance.claim: Management assures the ability to maintain EBITDA above 20%, specifically between 20% to 22% during the next two years.
guidance.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

guidance.claim: Management estimates revenues for FY27 to be more than INR 360 crores, exceeding prior targets.
guidance.quote: Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.

guidance.claim: Management assumes a growth in Alkop for the next 2 years at the rate of 29%.
guidance.quote: and we are assuming a growth in Alkop for the next 2 years at the rate of 29%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the recent visit to Canada and USA to yield substantial volumes in the coming period.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that third and fourth quarters are normally much better and not affected by the cyclic nature of the auto industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Third, fourth quarter, if you see, normally are much better. They are not affected by the cyclic nature of this auto industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to operate within its primary segment of auto components where sustained demand is being observed.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to operate within our primary segment of auto components where we are seeing sustained demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to the USA market have gone up by almost 50% over last year.
demand_outlook.quote: So far as USA market is concerned, our exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year so far as USA market is concerned and there is a lot of opportunities we are looking for.

demand_outlook.claim: European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India, leading to many new inquiries.
demand_outlook.quote: Since European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and they are tapping our doors and we'll be very happy to see that they come into our fold from the next year.

demand_outlook.claim: Raw material prices have been increasing significantly, but the company has been successful in passing on that burden to customers to a larger extent.
demand_outlook.quote: so far as material consumption is here raw material prices are going up, we were successful in passing on that burden of raw material to the customers to the larger extent.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reports a planned CapEx of around INR4 crores for Alkop alone for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

capex_expansion.claim: For the brake division, ₹0.58 crore capex was deployed in FY26, with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capital expenditure for Alkop is INR 7 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And for Alkop, it is INR7 crores and brakes, it is INR3 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Bi-metal sales increased year-on-year by 40.41% and EBITDA is up by approximately 60%.
margins_costs.quote: Now coming to the standalone performance of Bi-metal Menon Bearings, during the quarter sales increased to INR67.06 crores from INR47.76 crores as compared to the corresponding quarter of the last year that is year-on-year increase of 40.41% and further increased by about 41%. EBITDA is up by ~60%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA in the brakes segment reached 25% compared to 12% earlier.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool prices for automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Bi-metal EBITDA margins are around 21% plus, Alkop is almost 21%, and brakes achieved 25% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Okay. So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

margins_costs.claim: Export subvention of 2.75% is being offered by the government on request.
margins_costs.quote: Ministry of Commerce has considered, and they are now offering 2.75% subvention on export subsidy.

orders_capacity.claim: Bi-metal division capacity utilization stands at approximately 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Roughly, I will tell you bearing around 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Aluminium capacity utilization is around 65% to 70%.
Components under development or approved hold an annual revenue potential of approximately ₹55 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: These components hold a revenue potential of approximately ₹55 crore annually.

orders_capacity.claim: The new development parts pipeline includes 51 new parts across major customers representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new development parts pipeline is robust with 51 new parts across major customers like John Deere for India domestic and exports as well. Eaton, Taco Prestolite and Mayekawa representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bi-Metal division has a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With this, apart from this, in Bi-Metal division also, we are having a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline for brakes is almost INR 10 crores for the next two years.
orders_capacity.quote: And that for the breaks, it is almost INR 10 crores for the next two years.

orders_capacity.claim: Total order position on a consolidated basis is more than INR 32 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: You see, our current order position is more than INR32 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only without fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors declared a dividend of Rs. 2 per share on shares with a face value of Re. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital limits of INR 25 crores in PCFC will be availed to lower the interest cost down to 4.70% instead of 8%.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are going with PCFC limits, and we already talked, we have taken INR6 crores of loan from the bank so far as PCFC is concerned, which is available at the rate of 4% now, 4.70%,. So, over a period of time, when the total limits we are availing from the bankers is to the tune of INR25 crores so far as PCFC limits are concerned, so that the total cost at the rate of 4.70% instead of 8%, blocking will be higher because of debtors. So, we can bring down that total working capital limit, and at the same time, we'll be saving about 4% on working capital limit

capital_allocation.claim: Most of the planned capex will be financed with internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: and whatever capex is that we are going to do that most of it will be financed with internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck over the prior three months due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Total turnaround time of debtors is more than 180 days due to increased exports, particularly in the USA.
risks_headwinds.quote: since we have started the business and our exports have gone up, particularly in USA, the total turnaround time of debtors is more than 180 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export shipments to African countries through Dubai were halted for the last three months, resulting in a loss of about INR 2 crores of business.
risks_headwinds.quote: For last three months, we have -- that export is halted. That has affected to the extent of almost INR2 crores of business that we have lost during last three months.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: And just to give a more deeper explanation, by next month, August end, the machine is supposed to be commissioned at our end.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects initial brake business with railways to start at INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year and grow to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Aluminium division samples for US customers should be submitted by next year, 2027.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe by next year, Alkop also should be able -- samples should be submitted by next year, by 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching INR500 crores by 2030 or sooner within the next 2-3 years as an internal target.
management_commitments.quote: We were supposed to reach INR500 crore in 2030, but we are trying to do it as soon as possible. So, in the next 2-3 years, it's our internal target, but let's see.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reach an asset turnover of 2 by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: By '28, we should be reaching that 100%.

management_commitments.claim: EBITDA margins will be maintained between 20% to 22% during the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Alkop capacity utilization is likely to go up to 90% by the end of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Utilization as of now is 65% and it is likely to go up to 90% by the end of this year so that we will have to engage another furnace next year.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer testing machine for the brake division is expected to arrive by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: That is under production and we will be receiving it by the end of August and thereafter we will take up the business not only of railways but OEMs business also will be in our fold, I am sure.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
